messages:
sre-bot: 🚨 Paging: scaling-degradation detected for `dedicated-gpu-pool-usw2`

sre-bot: symptoms: queue_depth > 500 (5m avg), 95th latency spikes to 6s, GPU util ~98% on pool, HPA not adding pods (stuck at 12). Impact: some hosted routes returning 502/504 or long tails.

maria: ack. I'm on it — grabbing HPA and pod states. Will post quick snapshot.

maria: pasted `kubectl` outputs below
```
$ kubectl get hpa -n redwood-serving
NAME                     REFERENCE                       TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
model-runtime-hpa        Deployment/model-runtime        85%/85%      2         50        12      4d
batch-worker-hpa         Deployment/batch-worker        120%/80%     0         10         8      12h
```

maria: pods in `dedicated-gpu-pool-usw2`
```
$ kubectl get pods -n gpu-usw2 -o wide
model-runtime-12abc   Running   0/1   98% GPU   10d
model-runtime-34def   Pending   0/1   0%        3m   Reason: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu
model-runtime-56ghi   Running   0/1   97% GPU   11d
warmup-init-78jkl     CrashLoop BackOff  warmup failed: timeout
```

maria: logs from warmup-init container: 
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] warmup start for model v2.1
[2026-03-15T09:12:08Z] downloading weights 6.1GB from s3://models/v2.1
[2026-03-15T09:12:22Z] decompress ok
[2026-03-15T09:12:40Z] mmap failed: cannot allocate memory
[2026-03-15T09:12:41Z] warmup timeout, exiting
```

kevin: adding context — autoscaler metrics show surge in queue depth correlated with a release spike at ~09:10 UTC. See Grafana panel (link): https://grafana.redwood/board/queue-depth?from=09:05&to=09:20 :eyes:

kevin: quick hypothesis list:
- H1: sudden traffic spike exhausted GPU pool; HPA hit maxReplicas and couldn't provision due to cluster node capacity/quota.
- H2: warmup jobs are timing out (OOM/mmap) causing pods to fail to become ready, so effective capacity is lower than replicas show.
- H3: orchestration bug — HPA metrics adapter returning stale CPU metrics so it didn't scale earlier.

maria: agree. Also seeing `Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu` on Pending pods -> possible node autoscaler throttled or cloud quota.

tara: FYI customer-reported error samples: "model response timed out" and 502s between 09:12-09:25 UTC from 3 enterprise tenants. I've collected request IDs and forwarding to the thread.

maria: mitigation executed: increased `model-runtime-hpa` maxReplicas from 50 -> 80 and triggered emergency scale via `kubectl scale --replicas=80 deploy/model-runtime -n redwood-serving`.

maria: also submitted a cloud quota increase request to infra (ticket #INC-2026-331).

ops-bot: Deploy job `scale-emergency` succeeded: replicas=80 -> 80/80 desired.

kevin: after scale: queue_depth dropped from 520 -> 120 over ~4m, 95th latency back to 1.2s. However, we still have warmup failures for some nodes with mmap errors. That suggests memory pressure on init sidecars or kernel limits.

maria: captured kernel dmesg from one host: `Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (warmup-init) score 987 or sacrifice child` — looks like host-level OOM killing the warmup process.

kevin: note: our warmup container uses `--mmap-alloc` which increases virtual memory needs; on smaller instance types (p4d-lite) this fails under memory oversubscription.

jonas: I'm taking the handoff for next shift. Summary for handoff to SRE morning:
- timeline: 09:05 traffic spike -> 09:10 queue depth spike -> 09:12 warmup-init OOMs -> 09:15 HPA at max -> 09:18 manual scale to 80 -> 09:22 queue drains, 95th latency recovers
- impact: brief client 502s / timeouts for high-cost tenants (3 customers) between 09:12-09:25 UTC. Postmortem needed.
- immediate open items: collect full pod-level logs for warmup-init; collect kernel/drain events for nodes; check cluster autoscaler logs and AWS quota API for GPU provisioning failures.

jonas: I'll add an incident doc and start timeline building. tagging @kevin @maria for outstanding hypotheses.

kevin: quick data dump I pushed to thread storage: s3://redwood-incidents/1778212345/ — contains `kubectl describe` outputs, warmup logs, grafana screenshots, and request samples.

maria: action items we did/need:
- [done] emergency scale to 80 replicas (mitigated tail latency) :white_check_mark:
- [done] notify infra for quota increase (ticket INC-2026-331) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
- [todo] gather warmup-init container cgroup memory usage and full dmesg for OOM hunts :mag:
- [todo] reproduce warmup on p4d-lite testbed to confirm mmap/OOM behavior :computer:
- [todo] evaluate lowering warmup concurrency and enable streaming cold-start fallback (route to smaller model variant while warmup completes) :repeat:

tara: adding customer impact note for postmortem: include list of affected request IDs and SLA hit calc. I can pull the subset from logging.

jonas: tagging on-call rotation: @kevin you can hand back once warmup logs collected. I'll own RCA writeup and follow-up on autoscaler tuning.

kevin: will collect the required logs and attach to the s3 folder by EOD. Also will prototype change to HPA adapter to use queue_depth metric directly for scale-up (less dependent on CPU).

maria: for mitigation runbook updates: propose adding emergency scale run: `kubectl scale deploy/model-runtime --replicas=<emergency>` and a play to switch route fallback to `model-runtime-v1-small` if warmup percent_ready < 80%. I'll draft PR for runbook.

ops-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, incident_id=INC-1778212345, status=stabilized.

jonas: logging next steps for RCA: timeline, root cause hypotheses (HPA max + node quota + warmup OOM), evidence to collect (node autoscaler logs, kernel OOM logs, HPA metric timeseries, warmup container memory profiles), remediation candidates (increase node types for pool, lower mmap footprint, enable streaming fallback, add queue-depth-driven HPA).

maria: note for postmortem — include exact cloud instance types impacted and rate of failed node provisioning. Infra mention: tagging @infra-team in the doc.

kevin: closing note: no further customer errors after 09:30 UTC, keeping monitoring alert thresholds tighter: queue_depth alert from 300->200 for 2m to catch earlier next time. :eyes:

jonas: thanks all — handing off to you @kevin for follow-ups. I'll open the RCA doc and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:
